name: Citizenship by Birth/Descent

requirements.blocker_text: Born in Uganda, with a parent or grandparent who is or was a member of one of the indigenous communities existing in Uganda before 1 February 1926.

requirement_groups.name: Parent or grandparent a citizen by birth

requirements.blocker_text: Born anywhere (in or outside Uganda) to a parent or grandparent who held Ugandan citizenship by birth.

evidence_required.document: Parent/grandparent's proof of indigenous-community membership or citizenship by birth

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Uganda (Embassy of Uganda, Washington DC) -- Citizenship & Dual Citizenship: citizenship by birth/descent applies to persons born in Uganda with 'one of whose parents or grandparents is or was a member of any of the indigenous communities' existing before 1 February 1926, or born anywhere to a parent/grandparent who held Ugandan citizenship by birth; also covers foundlings under age 5 with unknown parents (presumed citizens by birth) and children under 18 adopted by Ugandan citizens (registrable as citizens)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uganda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 official diplomatic mission sourced. Two structurally distinct descent routes modeled as separate requirement_groups: an ethnicity/indigenous-community-based track (requiring the child to be born IN Uganda, tied to a pre-1926 colonial-era cutoff -- worth noting this shares the same 'listed indigenous community' structural mechanism seen in other East/Central African citizenship laws in this dataset, though without the severe exclusionary consequences documented for Myanmar's equivalent 1823 cutoff) and an ordinary citizen-parent/grandparent descent track (available regardless of birthplace, the more commonly-used mechanism for diaspora children). Foundling and adoption provisions are disclosed in the source citation but not modeled as separate requirement_groups given their narrower scope (foundlings under 5 with unknown parents; adopted minors under 18). dual_citizenship_allowed TRUE, consistent with Uganda's general dual-citizenship permission (see ug_dual_citizenship.json).
